versions.changelog:
Initial release of the cooling-circulating-water-expert skill:

- Provides end-to-end design, chemical formula recommendations, operation optimization, and troubleshooting for industrial cooling circulating water systems.
- Supports analysis of large-scale water quality data to generate scaling inhibitor, corrosion inhibitor, and biocide formulas with dosing strategies.
- Outputs process design reports (PDF) and chemical formula sheets (Excel), plus water and energy saving proposals.
- Accepts user requirements and optional onsite water quality parameters for tailored recommendations.
- Includes guidelines for compliance with local regulations and instructions for use in WorkBuddy.
